title: Infrastructure L2 support Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled Infrastructure L2 Support Engineer to manage and support cloud infrastructure, Microsoft services, and enterprise IT operations. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and Intune, along with strong incident management and troubleshooting skills. **Key Responsibilities**

Provide Level 2 (L2) support for infrastructure-related incidents and service requests across Microsoft technologies.

Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft Intune. Monitor infrastructure alerts, investigate issues, perform root cause analysis, and resolve incidents within defined SLAs.

Provide P1/P2 incident support, including on-call support and escalation management. Perform system patching, vulnerability remediation, backup verification, and disaster recovery (DR) testing.

Support user access management, identity administration, and security configurations across Microsoft services. Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, CMDB records, shift handover notes, and knowledge base articles. Coordinate with L3 teams, vendors, and other IT stakeholders to resolve complex technical issues. Follow ITIL-based incident, problem, and change management processes. Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure stability, security, and operational efficiency.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

3–5 years of relevant experience in infrastructure support, cloud administration, or Microsoft enterprise services.

Mandatory Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104) certification.

Mandatory ITIL Foundation certification.

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure administration and Microsoft 365 services. Strong knowledge of Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, and Intune administration. Experience in incident management, troubleshooting, monitoring, and SLAdriven support.

Understanding of patch management, vulnerability remediation, backup verification, and disaster recovery processes. Familiarity with ITSM tools, CMDB management, and operational documentation. Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Willingness to provide on-call support for critical P1/P2 incidents.

**Preferred Certifications**

MS-102: Microsoft 365 Administrator

MD-102: Endpoint Administrator

AZ-500: Azure Security Engineer Key Competencies Infrastructure and cloud operations Microsoft 365 administration Incident and problem management Security and vulnerability management Disaster recovery and business continuity Documentation and stakeholder communication

title: Sr. Engineer II - Tech Support
description:
**Job Title:** Senior Support Engineer – Data Integration & Support

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own day-to-day operational support for integration pipelines built on SnapLogic (or equivalent ETL/iPaaS tools) and dbt-based transformation workflows
* Monitor pipeline health, proactively identify failures/bottlenecks, and drive root-cause analysis and permanent fixes (not just workarounds)

* Manage on-call rotations and escalation processes

* Partner with client-side counterparts to review open issues, prioritize backlog, and communicate status transparently

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Hands-on experience with SnapLogic (or similar ETL/integration tools — Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, MuleSoft) in a production support capacity
* Strong working knowledge of dbt (models, tests, macros, documentation, CI/CD for transformations)
* Prior experience in a Managed Services / Application Support / L2-L3 support environment — ticketing tools (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management), incident management, SLA-driven delivery
* SQL proficiency and experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar)
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) and orchestration/monitoring tools
* Experience leading or mentoring a small support team
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills under time pressure
* Excellent communication skills — comfortable interfacing directly with client stakeholders

title: Systems Development Engineer II, FO Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon.com is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization team that helps promise, plan, and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide — faster and cheaper each day — while providing an extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle millions of requests per second and make business recommendations that impact billions of dollars each year. With rapid expansion into new geographies, increasing complexity of the transportation network, and an expanding selection of products, the Fulfillment Optimization team builds solutions that scale and propel the business with best-in-class technology innovations.  
  
We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission-critical, high-volume applications — and who are excited to apply AI and agentic automation to how large-scale systems are supported and operated. You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.  
  
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency.  
  
As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier — enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Dive deeply into technical details to diagnose, reproduce, and root-cause issues across Amazon technology products (services, tools, data solutions, etc.), and drive them to resolution or escalation.
* Design, build, and operate AI-powered and agentic support capabilities — diagnostic agents, automated root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and self-healing/auto-remediation — that detect and prevent issues before they impact customers.
* Apply AI across the software development lifecycle (spec-driven and AI-assisted development, agentic workflows) to raise engineering velocity and quality.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks to increase efficiency and reduce manual toil, and build tooling that enables other engineers.
* Manage trouble tickets through to resolution or escalation using existing documentation, procedures, and tools, and improve those mechanisms over time.
* Use technology to monitor security vulnerabilities and eliminate risk; identify and mitigate reliability risks at the team and component level.
* Improve service resilience, performance, and operational metrics; define and apply operational-excellence practices for the team.
* Participate in a team on-call rotation, providing operational support for the services the team owns.
* Collaborate with partner teams, Technical Program Managers, and Product Managers to deliver on shared goals.
* Work in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology.

  
About the team  
The Fulfillment Optimization (FO) Support team plays a crucial role in Amazon's supply chain operations. We invent and deliver software solutions that facilitate Customer Promise Speed, Order Planning, and Fulfillment.  
  
The FO Support team leverages data, process improvement, and innovative technologies — including AI and agentic automation — to provide comprehensive engineering-excellence services and solutions across FO's product portfolios. The team is responsible for FO services as front-line support and plays a central role in the organization's success.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building services using AWS products
* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience leveraging AI (Artificial Intelligence) agents for security review automation, spec-driven development practices, or adversarial red teaming
* Experience building or integrating AI/GenAI-powered solutions (e.g., LLM-based tools, agentic frameworks, automated diagnostics or remediation)
* Ability to work independently and solve problems using knowledge of an object-oriented programming language

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: IT Quality Specialist - Pharma R&D
description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

The IT Quality Specialist independently manages the end\-to\-end quality and analysis tasks across various capabilities and contributes to solving moderately complex business problems. You will lead the analysis of stakeholders needs, drive root cause analysis, and ensure comprehensive requirements traceability across large\-scale initiatives. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will champion accountability, mentor junior team members, and drive process improvements that align delivered solutions with overarching business goals.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and UX Designers, to define scope, solutions, constraints, and project risks.
* Manage compliance documentation processes and systems, characterizing business solutions for compliance with internal and external regulations.
* Be accountable for the creation and maintenance of:
* System Risk Assessments and Data Classification Reports.
* User Requirements and Functional/Technical Specifications.
* Validation Plans, Reports, and Registries.
* Requirements Traceability Matrices, Test Plans, and Test Reports.
* Data/Process flow diagrams and training documentation.
* Configure system settings and provide consultation to customers regarding solution enhancements and new implementations.
* Facilitate UAT planning and execution.
* Serve as a trusted partner for Global Privacy, IT Security, and Business Quality teams, maintaining expert\-level knowledge of governance standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485\).
* Drive the resolution of business or systems issues throughout the project lifecycle.
* Enhance the creation and maintenance of compliance documentation (e.g., System Risk Assessments, Validation Plans, Requirements Traceability Matrices) by leveraging AI\-driven automation to reduce manual effort while maintaining compliance rigor.
* Implement AI\-assisted quality control tools to automate data validation, anomaly detection, and cross\-platform consistency checks, ensuring sustained data integrity and adherence to GxP/CSV standards at scale.
* Utilize AI\-powered analytical tools to monitor platform performance, proactively identify process bottlenecks, and generate audit\-ready compliance metrics.
* Guide the strategic deployment of AI agents within the IT Quality landscape, ensuring that AI\-assisted workflows remain compliant by design and effectively support business requirements.


Experience Profile
  
  

* 7\-10 years of related experience in an IT business systems analyst or IT quality assurance role.
* Strong domain knowledge of the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, manufacturing/quality assurance processes, and computer systems validation (CSV).
* Proven understanding of application development methodologies (Agile and Waterfall), including functional requirements, process modeling, and large\-scale system implementations.
* BA/BS degree in life science, informatics, business, or equivalent (MA/MS or post\-graduate coursework is a plus).
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships, focus on the customer, and solve complex problems in fast\-paced environments.
* Strong capability to independently apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis.
* Ability to champion accountability by example, drive process improvement initiatives, and mentor junior team members.


\#Hyderabad2026
  
  

Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

title: Jr. Desktop Support Engineer
description:
At Meazure Learning, we aim to empower open\-minded, inquisitive, and driven people, and we love how each new addition to the team adds to our culture. Here, you can positively impact the careers of millions of test\-takers and reshape the education technology landscape by working toward one vision:


“To provide life\-long learners across the globe the freedom to pursue their academic dreams and career aspirations safely, securely, and conveniently.”


Our Vision starts with our values—Hungry, Humble and Smart. We are looking for team members who model drive for results. Team members who think of the organization and team first without ego or agenda. Leaders who instinctively collaborate and operate with emotional intelligence. This is the foundation of success for all employees at Meazure Learning.

**The Role:**


We are looking for a motivated and tech\-savvy individual to join our IT team as a Jr. Desktop Support Engineer. The Desktop Support Engineer will be responsible for providing technical assistance and support to end\-users, ensuring that all desktop systems, hardware, software, and peripheral devices function efficiently.

**The Responsibilities:**

* Provide Technical Support: Assist in troubleshooting and resolving hardware and software issues on desktops, laptops, and other devices.
* Installation and Configuration: Install, configure, and maintain operating systems, software applications, and hardware peripherals.
* User Assistance: Respond to user inquiries and provide support via phone, email, or in\-person to resolve technical issues promptly.
* System Maintenance: Perform regular maintenance tasks, including system updates, backups, and patch management.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate records of support requests, resolutions, and hardware/software inventories.
* Continuous Learning: Stay updated on the latest technology trends, software updates, and industry best practices.

**Additional Position Information:**

* Onsite
* Location: HYDW
* Core Hours: Rotational Shift
* Core Days Worked: To be determined

**The Desired Attributes:**

* **The Desired Attributes:**
	+ **Education**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.
	+ **Experience**: Fresher
	+ **Technical Skills**:
* + Knowledge in Windows and macOS operating systems.
	+ Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and other common software applications.
	+ Experience with hardware troubleshooting and repair.
	+ Familiarity with network concepts and troubleshooting
	+ Understanding of Active Directory.
	+ **Soft Skills**:
* + Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
	+ Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	+ Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	+ Customer\-oriented approach with a focus on delivering high\-quality support**Working Conditions:**


	+ Office environment with occasional requirements for on\-site support.
	+ Ability to lift and move computer equipment as needed.
	+ Availability for occasional after\-hours support and on\-call duties.

* Competitive Pay
* Healthy work Culture
* Career Growth Opportunities
* Learning and Development Opportunities
* Company Sponsored Health Insurance
* Referral Award Program
